verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Sabbaha Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa huwal-azeezul-hakeem
Lahu mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi yuhyee wa yumeetu wa huwa alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Huwal-awwalu wal-aakhiru waz-zaahiru wal-baatinu wa huwa bikulli shay'in aleem

Huwal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda fee sittati ayyaamin thumma istawaa alal-arshi ya'lamu maa yaliju fil-ardi wa maa yakhruju minhaa wa maa yanzilu minas-samaa'i wa maa ya'ruju feehaa wa huwa ma'akum ayna maa kuntum Wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona baseer
Lahu mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa ilaa Allaahi turja'ul-umoor
Yoolijul-layla fin-nahaari wa yoolijun-nahaara fil-layli wa huwa aleemun bidhaatis-sudoor
Aaminoo Billaahi wa rasoolihi wa anfiqoo mimmaa ja'alakum mustakhlafeena feehi fa-al-ladheena aamanoo minkum wa anfaqoo lahum ajrun kabeer
Wa maa lakum laa tu'minoona Billaahi war-rasoolu yad'ookum litu'minoo birabbikum wa qad akhadha meethaaqakum in kuntum mu'mineen
Huwal-ladhee yunazzilu alaa abdihi aayaatin bayyinaatin liyukhrijakum minaz-zulumaati ilan-noori wa innallaaha bikum lara'oofun Raheem

Wa maa lakum allaa tunfiqoo fee sabeelillaahi wa Lillaahi meeraathus-samaawaati wal-ardi laa yastawee minkum man anfaqa min qablil-fathi wa qaatala ulaa'ika a'zamu darajatan minal-ladheena anfaqoo min ba'du wa qaataloo wa kullan wa-ada Allaahul-husnaa Wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona khabeer
Man dhal-ladhee yuqridu Allaaha qardan hasanan fayudaa'ifahu lahu wa lahu ajrun kareem
Yawma taral-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati yas'aa nooruhum bayna aydeehim wa bi-aymaanihim bushraakumul-yawma jannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa dhaalika huwal-fawzul-azeem

Yawma yaqoolul-munaafiqoona wal-munaafiqaatu lilladheena aamanoo unzuroonaa naqtabis min noorikum qeelar-ji'oo waraa'akum faltamisoo nooran faduriba baynahum bisoorin lahu baabun baatinuhu feehir-rahmatu wa zaahiruhu min qibalihil-adhaab
Yunaadoonahum alam nakun ma'akum qaaloo balaa wa laakinnakum fatantum anfusakum wa tarabbastum wartabtum wa gharratkumul-amaaniyyu hattaa jaa'a amru Allaahi wa gharrakum Billaahil-gharoor
Fal-yawma laa yu'ukhadhu minkum fidyatun wa laa minal-ladheena kafaroo ma'waakumun-naaru hiya mawlaakum wa bi'sal-maseer

Alam ya'ni lilladheena aamanoo an takhsha'a quloobuhum lidhikri Allaahi wa maa nazala minal-haqqi wa laa yakoonoo kal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba min qablu fataala alayhimul-amadu faqasat quloobuhum wa katheerun minhum faasiqoon
I'lamoo annallaaha yuhyil-arda ba'da mawtihaa qad bayyannaa lakumul-aayaati la-allakum ta'qiloon
Innal-mussaddiqeena wal-mussaddiqaati wa aqradoo Allaaha qardan hasanan yudaa'afu lahum wa lahum ajrun kareem
Wal-ladheena aamanoo Billaahi wa rusulihi ulaa'ika humus-siddeeqoona wash-shuhadaa'u inda rabbihim lahum ajruhum wa nooruhum wal-ladheena kafaroo wa kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa ulaa'ika ashaabul-jaheem

I'lamoo annamal-hayaatud-dunyaa la-ibun wa lahwun wa zeenatun wa tafaakhurun baynakum wa takaathurun fil-amwli wal-awlaadi kamathali ghaythin a'jabal-kuffaara nabaatuhu thumma yaheeju fataraahu musfarran thumma yakoonu hutaaman wa fil-aakhirati adhaabun shadeedun wa maghfiratun mina Allaahi wa ridwaanun wa mal-hayaatud-dunyaa illaa mataa'ul-ghuroor

Saabiqoo ilaa maghfiratin min rabbikum wa jannatin arduhaa ka'ardis-samaa'i wal-ardi u'iddat lilladheena aamanoo Billaahi wa rusulihi dhaalika fadlu Allaahi yu'teehi man yashaa'u Wallaahu dhul-fadlil-azeem
Maa asaaba min museebatin fil-ardi wa laa fee anfusikum illaa fee kitaabin min qabli an nabra'ahaa inna dhaalika alaa Allaahi yaseer
Likaylaa ta'saw alaa maa faatakum wa laa tafrahoo bimaa aataakum Wallaahu laa yuhibbu kulla mukhtaalin fakhoor
Al-ladheena yabkhaloona wa ya'muroonan-naasa bil-bukhli wa man yatawalla fa-innallaaha huwal-ghaniyyul-hameed

Laqad arsalnaa rusulanaa bil-bayyinaati wa anzalnaa ma'ahumul-kitaaba wal-meezaana liyaqooman-naasu bil-qisti wa anzalnal-hadeeda feehi ba'sun shadeedun wa manaafi'u lin-naasi wa liya'lama Allaahu man yansuruhu wa rusulahu bil-ghaybi innallaaha qawiyyun azeez
Wa laqad arsalnaa noohan wa ibraaheema wa ja'alnaa fee dhurriyyatihiman-nubuwwata wal-kitaaba faminhum muhtadin wa katheerun minhum faasiqoon

Thumma qaffaynaa alaa aathaarihim birusulinaa wa qaffaynaa bi-eesaa ibni maryama wa aataynaahul-injeela wa ja'alnaa fee quloobil-ladheena ittaba'oohu ra'fatan wa rahmatan wa rahbaaniyyatan ibtada'oohaa maa katabnaahaa alayhim illab-tighaa'a ridwaani Allaahi famaa ra'awhaa haqqa ri'aayatihaa fa-aataynal-ladheena aamanoo minhum ajrahum wa katheerun minhum faasiqoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo ittaqoo Allaaha wa aaminoo birasoolihi yu'tikum kiflayni min rahmatihi wa yaj'al lakum nooran tamshoona bihi wa yaghfir lakum Wallaahu ghafoorun Raheem
Li-allaa ya'lama ahlul-kitaabi allaa yaqdiroona alaa shay'in min fadlillaahi wa annal-fadla biyadi Allaahi yu'teehi man yashaa'u Wallaahu dhul-fadlil-azeem
